headline: Brazil Federal State Enterprises Post Record September Deficit of R$ 2B
summary: Brazil's federal state-owned companies registered a primary deficit of 2.014 billion reais in September, marking the highest monthly deficit on record for that month according to the Central Bank of Brazil.
why: State-owned company deficits add directly to Brazil's consolidated public sector borrowing requirements, influencing fiscal deficit targets and bond yields.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Record deficits among state entities widen overall public sector debt and undermine fiscal targets.
